values.description: CaseXchange backend base URL. Use localhost for local dev; switch env for QA/UAT/production.
Public API base URL — derived from base_url. Do not edit directly.
Internal API base URL — used for auth login and key management.
Public API key (format: cxp_ro_..., cxp_std_..., or cxp_full_...). Populated automatically by key creation requests.
JWT access token for internal API authentication. Populated automatically by the Login request.
Firm UUID. Populated automatically by Get Own Firm or Get Firm Directory. Used in Firms and Routing requests.
Case UUID. Populated automatically by Create Case or List Cases. Used in Cases and Documents requests.
Document UUID. Populated automatically by Upload Document or List Documents.
User UUID. Populated automatically by Invite User or List Users.
Routing rule UUID. Populated automatically by Create Rule or List Rules.
Med case UUID. Populated automatically by Create Med Case or List Med Cases.
Med referral UUID. Populated automatically by Create Referral on Med Case or List Referrals on Med Case.
Public API key record UUID (not the plaintext key value). Used for Get Key Usage and Revoke API Key requests in Key Management.
Appointment UUID. Populated automatically by List/Create Appointment requests. Used in Med Appointments & Billing requests.
Billing line UUID. Populated automatically by List/Create Billing Line requests. Used in Med Appointments & Billing requests.
Target firm UUID for Network relationship endpoints. Set manually to the partner firm's ID.
Webhook subscription UUID. Populated automatically by Create Webhook Subscription or List Webhook Subscriptions. Used throughout the Webhooks folder.

Webhook HMAC signing secret (whsec_...). Populated automatically by Create Webhook Subscription and Rotate Webhook Secret — those are the only two responses that return it. Use it to verify X-CaseXchange-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, "<t>.<rawBody>")).
Internal login email used for key-management endpoints. Override per environment as needed.
Internal login password used for key-management endpoints. Override per environment as needed.
Case type id. Set it from List Case Types. Used by List Case Type Fields.
Custom field id. Set it from the case type fields response.
Insurance record id. Populated by the Insurance requests.
External link id. Populated by Create External Link.
Med case document id. Populated automatically by Upload a MedEx case document.
Pharmacy fill id. Populated automatically by Record a dispensed fill.
Pharmacy ledger transaction id. Populated automatically by Record a payment or adjustment.
Referral UUID. Populated by the Referrals requests.
Salesforce connection id. Used by the Salesforce requests.
Sent case UUID. Populated by Create Sent Case or List Sent Cases.
Salesforce token id. Populated by Generate Token.
